name: EventsPage - Archive And Recent
description: The events body on its own, away from the Luma calendar that sits above it on the real page: one recent past event as a card, the link out to Luma's full past list, and the imported 2013-2018 history folded into a closed row per year. This is the state the /events route reaches too, shown here because the calendar embed is tall enough to push the archive off the first screen.
